## Load packages

`enrichVolcano`, the user's own plotting package (not on CRAN), is called with `::`.

```{r setup}
pacman::p_load(here, dplyr, purrr, stringr, ggplot2, patchwork, readxl)
here::i_am("03_Pathway_Enrichment/02_enrich_volcano_fgsea/a_script/02_enrich_volcano_fgsea.qmd")
```

## Read results

This step computes nothing. It draws protein volcanoes with a ring of fgsea sets around each:
point colour reads protein-level BH FDR, the ring reads set-level fgsea FDR. The baseline
contrast is not drawn.

Both tables come from `01_run_fgsea_and_fry.xlsx`. Only fgsea sets that survived
`collapsePathways` (`main`) are kept for the rings. The leading edge, the set members that drive
fgsea's score, was saved as one `;`-joined string and is split back into a vector per set. fry's
significant sets per contrast go into the S8 caption. S9 labels each protein with its mean
observed precursors per sample (`pi_label`), so a thinly observed protein near the top of the pi
ranking reads as such.

```{r read}
tests <- here(
  "03_Pathway_Enrichment", "01_run_fgsea_and_fry", "c_data", "01_run_fgsea_and_fry.xlsx"
)
protein_results <- read_excel(tests, "protein_results") |>
  mutate(pi_label = sprintf("%s (%.1f)", label, mean_obs))
set_tests <- read_excel(tests, "set_tests")
fgsea_results <- set_tests |>
  filter(method == "fgsea", main) |>
  mutate(leadingEdge = str_split(leadingEdge, ";"))
fry_hits <- set_tests |>
  filter(method == "fry") |>
  summarise(hits = sum(padj < 0.05), .by = contrast)
count(fgsea_results, contrast)
fry_hits
```

## Match leading edges to labels

`plot_volcano_ring()` matches leading-edge genes against point labels, and a label carries an
accession when a symbol sits on more than one protein. S8 labels points with `label` and S9 with
`pi_label`, so each label column gets its own copy of the leading edges, with each symbol mapped
to the label of its representative protein, the one fgsea ranked. The map is the same in every
contrast, so the first contrast's rows build it.

```{r leading-edge-labels}
label_columns <- c(fdr = "label", pi = "pi_label")
representatives <- filter(protein_results, contrast == contrast[1], selected)
leading_edges <- map(label_columns, function(column) {
  gene_to_label <- set_names(representatives[[column]], representatives$gene)
  map(fgsea_results$leadingEdge, function(genes) unname(gene_to_label[genes]))
})
```

## Build plot inputs

`enrichVolcano` shortens set names by dropping the collection prefix. Once the prefix goes,
`GOBP_MUSCLE_CONTRACTION` and `REACTOME_MUSCLE_CONTRACTION` share a label, so a name whose stem
repeats within a contrast gets its collection appended. `as_enrichment()` builds one enrichment
object per label column from the set table.

```{r enrichment}
ring_sets <- fgsea_results |>
  mutate(
    stem = sub("^[A-Z0-9]+_", "", pathway),
    pathway = if_else(
      duplicated(stem) | duplicated(stem, fromLast = TRUE), paste0(pathway, " ", database), pathway
    ),
    .by = contrast
  ) |>
  select(contrast, database, pathway, NES, pval = p, padj, size = n)
enrichment <- map(leading_edges, function(edges) {
  enrichVolcano::as_enrichment(mutate(ring_sets, leadingEdge = edges), enrichment_test = "fgsea")
})
```

`as_da()` builds the differential-abundance object the volcano reads, again one per label
column. `ring_theme` sets base text size and greys out non-significant points.

```{r da}
da <- map(label_columns, function(column) {
  enrichVolcano::as_da(
    select(protein_results, protein, gene = all_of(column), contrast, logFC, t, P.Value, adj.P.Val),
    species = NULL
  )
})
ring_theme <- enrichVolcano::plot_theme(
  base_size = 10, base_family = "sans", ns = "#9a9a9a"
)
```

Contrast names serve as panel titles. The interaction also gets its formula as a subtitle,
because a difference of differences has no short name.

```{r subtitles}
contrast_subtitle <- c(
  Modality_x_Time_Interaction = "(BFR_Post - BFR_Pre) - (HLRT_Post - HLRT_Pre)"
)
```

## Draw volcanoes

`make_volcano()` takes a contrast name and a label rule and returns one ringed volcano. With
`rank_by = "fdr"` it names the five proteins with the lowest BH FDR below 0.05; with
`rank_by = "pi"` it names the five with the smallest pi-score, P.Value^|logFC|, which ranks and
selects nothing, each with its mean observed precursors. The ring draws the twelve collapse
survivors with the lowest adjusted p, in either direction.

The ring draws with `clip = "off"` on a square panel and puts the NES key on the right, so a
label on that edge lands on the colour bar. The key goes below the plot, where nothing collides.

```{r volcano-helper}
make_volcano <- function(cn, rank_by = "fdr") {
  points <- filter(protein_results, contrast == cn)
  if (rank_by == "pi") {
    labels <- arrange(points, pi_score, protein)$pi_label
    note <- "Labels ranked by pi-score (mean observed precursors); colours and counts use BH FDR"
  } else {
    labels <- arrange(filter(points, adj.P.Val < 0.05), adj.P.Val, P.Value, protein)$label
    note <- "Protein significance: BH FDR < 0.05"
  }
  labels <- head(labels, 5)
  enrichVolcano::plot_volcano_ring(
    da[[rank_by]], enrichment[[rank_by]],
    contrast = cn, collapse = FALSE, title = cn,
    subtitle = paste(na.omit(c(contrast_subtitle[cn], note)), collapse = "\n"),
    label_mode = if (length(labels)) "by_genes" else "none",
    label_genes = labels,
    label_size = 2.6, axis_size = 2.6, count_size = 2.8,
    # The longer pi labels reach the count badges, so those panels move the badges out.
    count_x_mult = if (rank_by == "pi") 0.85 else 0.7,
    point_size = 0.9, theme = ring_theme
  ) +
    guides(fill = guide_colorbar(direction = "horizontal", title.position = "top")) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, face = "plain"),
      plot.margin = margin(6, 28, 6, 28),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.justification = "center",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5),
      legend.key.height = unit(2, "mm"),
      legend.key.width = unit(16, "mm")
    )
}
```

`supplement()` takes a figure number, title and caption text and returns the patchwork
annotation with a supplement-style caption; `panel_list()` turns contrast names into the
"(A) name." list the captions open with. `ring_text` is the caption text both figures share.

```{r caption-helpers}
supplement <- function(number, title, text) {
  plot_annotation(
    caption = str_wrap(sprintf("S%d Figure. %s. %s", number, title, text), 115),
    tag_levels = "A",
    theme = theme(plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 9, lineheight = 1.2))
  )
}
panel_list <- function(contrasts) {
  paste(sprintf("(%s) %s.", LETTERS[seq_along(contrasts)], contrasts), collapse = " ")
}
ring_text <- paste(
  "The ring shows up to twelve fgsea sets that survived collapsePathways, lowest adjusted p",
  "first, in either direction, coloured by NES; ticks mark their leading-edge proteins. Protein",
  "colour and counts read protein-level BH FDR, the ring set-level fgsea FDR: two separate",
  "claims. Data: protein_results and set_tests sheets of 01_run_fgsea_and_fry.xlsx."
)
```

S8 puts the primary question first, then the two training responses and the between-treatment
comparison; its caption names the panels where fry finds no set. S9 repeats the training
responses with the same points, colours and rings; only the labels move, to the pi-score ranking,
so no protein named there is a discovery.

```{r figures}
fdr_order <- c(
  "Modality_x_Time_Interaction", "BFR_Post-Pre", "HLRT_Post-Pre", "BFR_Post-HLRT_Post"
)
pi_order <- c("BFR_Post-Pre", "HLRT_Post-Pre")
no_fry <- LETTERS[seq_along(fdr_order)][fdr_order %in% filter(fry_hits, hits == 0)$contrast]
figures <- list(
  wrap_plots(map(fdr_order, make_volcano), ncol = 2) +
    supplement(8, "Protein volcanoes with collapse-surviving fgsea sets ringed", paste(
      panel_list(fdr_order), "Points are proteins, coloured when BH FDR < 0.05 within the",
      "contrast, with the five lowest-FDR proteins named.",
      paste0("fry finds no set for panels ", paste(no_fry, collapse = " and "), "."), ring_text
    )),
  wrap_plots(map(pi_order, make_volcano, rank_by = "pi"), ncol = 1) +
    supplement(9, "Protein volcanoes labelled by pi-score", paste(
      panel_list(pi_order), "As S8 Figure, but the five proteins named are those with the",
      "smallest pi-score, P.Value^|logFC| (Xiao et al. 2014), each followed by its mean observed",
      "precursors per sample in brackets. Pi controls no error rate, so no protein named here is",
      "a discovery.", ring_text
    ))
)
```

## Save results

Both pages go to `b_reports/02_enrich_volcano_fgsea_figures.pdf`. The step writes no table.

```{r write-figures}
figure_file <- "02_enrich_volcano_fgsea_figures.pdf"
pdf(
  here("03_Pathway_Enrichment", "02_enrich_volcano_fgsea", "b_reports", figure_file),
  width = 8.27, height = 11.69
)
walk(figures, print)
invisible(dev.off())
length(figures)
```
